request.summary: Create an interactive English-language factory safety questionnaire with identity capture, three consecutive multiple-choice questions, a scored summary, internal datasource result collection, and automatic reset.
request.audience: Employees and visitors completing a short safety check on a shared touch display before entering a fictional vehicle assembly area.
request.primaryGoal: Make the complete safety-check journey obvious, fast, readable at signage distance, and maintainable through separate editable question and result datasources.

assumptions: The example uses the fictional Northline Mobility brand and synthetic identities; no real employee or customer data is packaged.
The experience is used on two landscape touch surfaces, 1920x1080 and 1366x768.
Completed results append to Results.rows only while running in the displayer; the editor and unbound previews never write customer data.
A production owner must define retention and access controls for participant names and corporate IDs before deployment.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The requested experience is a landscape factory touch station, so it is optimized for Full HD and a smaller 16:9 panel rather than unsupported portrait placements.

ownership.rationale: Safety owners edit question order, wording, answers, and explanations without rebuilding the app.
Completed sessions are customer-owned operational records kept outside the app package.
Operators can change public labels and timing without editing datasource structure or rebuilding.
Coordinated presets are safe defaults while Custom exposes a complete semantic palette.
Identity and answers exist only for the active session until the user submits.
A playlist, control content, or operator can reset an abandoned station remotely.
Scoring, required sequence, result schema, and visual composition are code-owned safety behavior.

views.purpose: Collect participant name and corporate ID.
Present one multiple-choice safety question at a time.
Show the achieved score and answer review before submission.
Confirm storage or explain a retryable write failure.

inputs.action: Start, enter identity, select answers, navigate, and submit.
Enter participant identity and activate focused controls.
Reset the active session to the start view.

session.expectation: Any activity restarts the inactivity timer; completion resets after the configured shorter delay.

outputs.expectation: Append exactly one completed session to Results.rows using the SDK atomic array operation.
outputs.failure: Keep the summary visible, show a retryable error, and do not claim that the result was saved.

outputs.expectation: Emit score and submission ID after a successful or editor-blocked preview completion.
outputs.failure: The stored result remains authoritative if event emission is unavailable.

rendering.rationale: Both accepted touch surfaces share a landscape family, but controls reallocate space instead of scaling hit targets as a bitmap.

motion.rationale: Short view transitions and progress movement establish continuity; Off removes non-essential motion.

branding.provenance: The example ships only the fictional Northline Mobility name and generated semantic colors.
branding.fallback: Use the coordinated Dark preset when no customer branding kit or reference is supplied.

settings.purpose: Primary invitation on the start view.
Delay before a completed station returns to start.
Privacy timeout for an abandoned active session.
Selects Off, Subtle, or Expressive transitions.
Selects the complete Dark, Light, or Custom semantic palette.

dynamicText.fallback: Wrap to two lines at the readable minimum.
dynamicText.rationale: The invitation is the primary start-view message and must remain complete.

dynamicText.fallback: Fit within three lines at 28px, then preserve the full prompt by reducing supporting spacing first.
dynamicText.rationale: Safety questions are essential instructions and cannot be ellipsized.

dynamicText.fallback: Wrap to two lines and expand the option row before reducing the touch target.
dynamicText.rationale: Every answer must remain complete enough for an informed safety decision.

states.expectation: The complete start state fills the primary landscape station without behaving like a small centered web form.
The light preset remains readable and all primary touch controls fit the smaller supported landscape station.
A long operator-authored welcome title remains complete at a readable size.
Pathological but realistic questions and option labels remain complete and touch targets remain usable.
A bound but empty question datasource shows a clear unavailable state and no start action.

behaviors.expectation: The participant cannot skip identity or questions and reaches an accurate scored summary.
Submission appends one result row to the separate preview internal datasource.
The completion view returns to start after the configured delay and clears identity and answers.
The resetSession command returns an active flow to start without writing a partial result.

visualDirection.summary: A focused industrial safety checkpoint with one action per view, strong route-like progress, and calm high-contrast typography rather than a generic form card.
signatureChoices: A vertical safety stripe and oversized numeric progress make the sequence legible at distance.
Answer controls resemble durable labeled station controls while retaining generous touch targets.
avoid: Automotive trademarks or real employee data

visualReview.intent: A trustworthy factory touch station where the next action and current progress are obvious from several meters away.
focus: Verify every question and answer remains complete with safe descender clearance at both declared surfaces.
Verify touch targets remain large and the layout never resembles a cramped desktop form.
Verify Dark, Light, and Custom palettes remain coherent and motion never obscures controls.
